hard_fails.name: punctuation_bans_held
hard_fails.note: No em/en dashes, double-hyphens, colons, or semicolons in body; only single-hyphen compounds.

hard_fails.name: mechanism_named_and_news_tied
hard_fails.note: CMS RHTP named and tied to mid-July final-funding-decision trigger in dossier.

hard_fails.name: every_layer_attributed
hard_fails.note: All four body layers and controlling actors present in selected_mechanism.layers[].

hard_fails.name: chokepoint_named
hard_fails.note: Layer 2 DOH Commissioner binary award/deny matches dossier chokepoint; not a generic stand-in.

criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.notes: First two lines are concrete and specific (actor, $272.2M, 403 applications, this-week news trigger), signal a correction is coming without snark, fit under ~210-char cutoff. Short of 10 because the mechanism by name (CMS Rural Health Transformation Program) only appears in line 3.

criteria.name: Mechanism load-bearing + AK consequence
criteria.notes: Mechanism genuinely drives an AK procurement/capital decision; consequence fully specified: sector (rural health data/AI), decision (who anchors FHIR-native interoperability), named actors (ANTHC, Southcentral, YKHC, SEARHC, vendors), timeframe (this week, budget close 10/30/2026).

criteria.name: Layer fidelity
criteria.notes: All four body layers and controlling actors match the dossier exactly; chain complete and readable. No invented layers.

criteria.name: Chokepoint clarity
criteria.notes: Names ONE layer (Layer 2), single actor (DOH Commissioner), binary decision (award/deny 403 applications, ~$272M), explicitly contrasted against ACF/CMS/Advisory Council. Asymmetric, not a committee.

criteria.name: Structural read
criteria.notes: Real grounded position ('a federal-to-state funnel that narrows, by design, to one desk'), proportionate and machinery-based, not snark. Not a flat explainer.

criteria.name: Forward implication
criteria.notes: Names concrete next decision points (notifications this week, budget close 10/30/2026), who is positioned, and what allocators should treat as the definitive map.

criteria.name: Primary-source quality
criteria.notes: Every layer traces to a primary source (TAGGS award RHTCMS332062, DOH program page, state public notice); chokepoint cited to DOH page; inline attribution; correctly drops the unsourced two-thirds ANTHC figure.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.notes: Analytical, structural, Alaska-first, business-literate, plain. No banned phrases, no influencer cadence.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.notes: 406 words, under 3,000 chars, well-formed 4-item bullet block. Held back because bullets are multi-clause with parentheticals and the fifth paragraph runs long as one block.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.notes: Real, debatable question tied directly to the chokepoint. No CTA, no rhetorical softener.
